title: Conqueror
summary: CONQUEROR, noun One who conquers; one who gains a victory; one who subdues and brings into subjection or possession, by force or by influence. The man who defeats his antagonist in combat is a conquer

inlines.v: CONQUEROR, noun One who conquers; one who gains a victory; one who subdues and brings into subjection or possession, by force or by influence. The man who defeats his antagonist in combat is a conqueror as is the general or admiral who defeats his enemy.
